scenarios.title: An external game authors one complete interactive object through supported contracts
given: the game is outside the Robusta repository and consumes only published SDK artifacts
when: the developer adds an interactive object and the player uses it in a networked session
then: the object uses game-defined components, systems, prototype configuration, lifecycle and gameplay events, localization, appearance, entity-bound UI, and authoritative replication
the game requires no Robusta source change, internal reference, or undocumented host hook
generated registration and synchronization metadata is deterministic and inspectable

scenarios.title: Incompatible games and versions coexist without shared mutable state
given: two incompatible games and two versions of one game are installed
when: the installations are launched independently
then: each selected installation runs with its exact runtime and dependencies
no installation observes mutable state belonging to another installation
selecting one version does not rewrite or invalidate the other

scenarios.title: An interrupted update preserves the last usable installation
given: a usable game installation exists and an update is available
when: the update is interrupted at each durable transition point
then: the prior installation remains selectable and usable
incomplete material is never presented as the completed release
the operator can return to the prior exact receipt

scenarios.title: Delivery processes do not acquire undeclared game execution authority
given: a launcher manages a game with distinct client and server material
when: the launcher and produced client package are audited
then: the launcher process has not loaded managed game assemblies
the client package contains no server-only assembly or resource

scenarios.title: Exact inputs produce one normalized catalog
given: two clean supported machines receive identical source and the same exact dependency lock
when: each machine compiles the content catalog
then: their normalized catalog outputs and fingerprints are identical
machine-specific paths, culture, ordering, and timestamps do not affect the result

scenarios.title: Invalid content reports stable source-quality diagnostics before launch
given: content contains an invalid reference or undeclared cross-package override
when: the normal development or release build validates the content
then: the build fails before launch
the diagnostic has a stable identity and reports the original file, location, offending identity, and corrective context

scenarios.title: A developer can inspect resolved content and its provenance
given: a catalog uses inheritance, patches, and two packages with the same local definition name
when: the developer inspects a resolved definition and a migration assessment
then: inspection shows final component values, inheritance, package source, and applied patches
package-qualified identities remain distinct
imported legacy content is classified as exact, converted with warning, manual, or unsupported

scenarios.title: Two clients remain governed by server authority under network faults
given: two compatible clients join one authoritative external-game session
when: players move and interact with shared state while latency, loss, duplication, and reordering are introduced
then: local movement may be predicted and remote movement smoothed without replacing server authority
shared interaction resolves to authoritative state
entities enter and leave interest correctly
a disconnected client can reconnect and resynchronize
an incompatible package or schema is rejected clearly before gameplay
the final state remains stable for the declared fault budget

scenarios.title: Public add-ons receive only declared capabilities
given: a public add-on fixture requests undeclared file, network, and process access
when: the add-on is validated and exercised through the supported public extension path
then: each undeclared operation is denied with an attributable diagnostic
the add-on cannot gain full-game execution authority through the launcher
installing a full executable game is presented separately as an explicit software trust decision

scenarios.title: Revocation prevents future launches without damaging unrelated installations
given: several verified packages are installed and one publisher or package is revoked
when: a future launch is attempted
then: the revoked selection is refused with its identity and reason
other installations and their writable data remain intact and usable

scenarios.title: Operator extensions do not silently become client content
given: a server installation declares a trusted operator extension
when: server and client packages are resolved and inspected
then: the extension is absent from client packages unless separately declared for that side and trusted
the package report identifies the extension, side, provenance, and trust tier

scenarios.title: An exact release receipt identifies and reproduces a game
given: a published game receipt and its recorded source and dependencies are available
when: the release is resolved or rebuilt on a clean supported machine
then: the selected runtime, game packages, dependencies, content, schemas, and fingerprints match the receipt
games requiring incompatible runtime versions can remain installed and run independently
any mismatch is reported before launch

scenarios.title: A saved world changes format only through an explicit recoverable migration
given: an older saved world and a game release that requires migration
when: the operator requests upgrade assessment and migration
then: a human-readable compatibility report identifies the required change
the original data is backed up before mutation
the migrated result becomes current only after validation succeeds
failure leaves a recoverable prior version

scenarios.title: A failed release update returns to the prior exact release without data loss
given: a working release and its writable data have an exact receipt and recoverable pre-update state
when: the next update fails installation, validation, migration, or startup
then: the prior receipt is selected again
its compatible writable data is restored without loss
the failure and rollback outcome are explicit

scenarios.title: The supported creator workflow makes every edit outcome visible
given: a clean supported machine, documented tool installation, and the published game template
when: the developer starts a server and two clients, makes a resource edit, a compatible content edit, and then a component-layout or network-schema edit
then: the developer reaches the playable workflow through the documented command
each edit is classified and reported
compatible changes become visible through the supported path
restart-required changes supervise a restart and return both clients to a playable session

scenarios.title: Creator supervision leaves no orphaned process
given: the creator workflow has started all required child processes
when: the workflow exits normally or fails at each supervised stage
then: all owned processes terminate within the stated budget
unrelated processes remain untouched
the diagnostic stream identifies each cleanup outcome

scenarios.title: Two worlds in one trusted host remain independent simulations
given: one trusted host creates two worlds from compatible game definitions
when: both worlds advance and create coincidentally equal local identity values
then: time, entities, systems, events, and mutable services advance independently
a local identity from one world never resolves an object in the other
untrusted or incompatible executable games still require separate processes

scenarios.title: Destroying one world releases only that world's resources
given: a host, sessions, and two active worlds exist
when: one world is destroyed
then: that world's mutable resources become unreachable and are released within the stated budget
the host, sessions, and other world continue unaffected
stale world-local identities cannot resolve into later worlds

scenarios.title: One world contains several maps and supports explicit movement between them
given: a normal world and an editor preview or test world can run beside one another
when: one world creates several maps and explicitly moves an entity between two of them
then: the maps remain parts of the same isolated simulation
the move has one observable before-and-after result without creating a second entity identity
the preview or test world cannot mutate the normal world

scenarios.title: Worlds share immutable definitions while all simulation mutation stays scoped
given: two worlds use one read-only catalog generation
when: each world mutates spawned values, timers, systems, random state, maps, physics, and replication state
then: the catalog remains unchanged and shareable
every mutation is observable only in its owning world
a prototype recipe may be shared while each spawned object's values remain world-local
architecture checks reject undeclared mutable gameplay state at process or catalog scope

scenarios.title: Host and player sessions survive explicit world replacement
given: a host has an authenticated player session, two worlds, and a declared durable service
when: the player detaches from an avatar, one world is replaced, and the session attaches to an avatar in the other world
then: the host, listener, authenticated session, durable service, and unaffected world remain active
avatar attachment changes only through the explicit operation
the durable service does not expose either world's private entities
logs, metrics, saves, and network diagnostics identify the responsible game, host, session, and world
a development catalog change is either adopted transactionally or produces a documented restart outcome

scenarios.title: Entity identity is independent from optional platform capabilities
given: a game models players, doors, items, projectiles, stacks, visual effects, UI, and durable records
when: the game assigns identity only where independent participation and lifecycle require it
then: components and systems model normal independent world participants
an entity remains valid without transform, display name, prototype origin, network synchronization, or save policy
splitting a quantity creates a second identity only when independent life begins
presentation-only effects and UI controls need not enter the authoritative world
world-wide rules and durable accounts use their proper ownership scopes rather than immortal entities
inspection distinguishes entity, structure, collection, network, and definition identities

scenarios.title: Station-like construction uses purpose-built dense data without losing behavior
given: a large editable tilemap and loose construction-material entities
when: a player creates the first structural cell, expands it through lattice, plating, and flooring, deconstructs layers, and removes a connection that splits the structure
then: structure identities are created, expanded, or split when independent lifecycle requires them
installed cells remain purpose-built addressable data rather than one general entity per cell
attached or contained objects are reassigned correctly after a split
game rules can convert loose material into cell state and back into an item
construction remains correctly inspectable, validated, saved, synchronized, and collidable
the representative scale fixture meets its published budgets
